text: No significant deforestation occurred on this asset after 2020. Earth-observation data (2021–2025) detected no tree-cover loss events larger than 0.5 hectares within the asset boundary. While minor changes (under 0.5 ha) or edge losses might have gone unnoticed due to pixel resolution limits (30m), the evidence confirms no major deforestation events took place. The asset had negligible forest cover (0 ha) as of 2020, per JRC data, and prior losses (e.g., 67.7 ha in 2020) occurred before the baseline. Observations were valid for the entire asset, with annual monitoring up to 2025.
